scope: Read-only independent diffraction pressure audit. No published coefficients, pressure observations, parity status or public datasets changed.

reference.pressure_method_in_paper: Ruby fluorescence before/after each measurement; reported error from the difference

protocol.silicon_standard: Installed pyFAI Si d-spacings; original Fit2D Si standard list/certificate not recovered
protocol.geometry_validation: Three dates; eight-ring and fifteen-ring direct fits, leave-one-ring-out checks and independent pyFAI implementation; recovered original Fit2D screenshot geometry verified on Si ring controls.
protocol.geometry_for_displayed_independent_estim: Recovered original si1702001.doc Fit2D settings; approximate geometry-transfer correction applied to individually fitted raw radial positions, averaged uniformly over detector azimuth. Alternative calibrations retained as sensitivity checks.
protocol.line_indexing: Blind four-reflection fcc candidate search; manual profiles and accepted sector distributions inspected. Candidate scores are heuristic, not statistical phase probabilities.
protocol.excluded_pressure_reflection: 111: adjacent bright scattering and/or reflection/azimuth-dependent shifts; retained as a diagnostic.
protocol.profile_fitting: Independent Gaussian plus local linear background per reflection; equal average of three lattice parameters. No Fe3C EOS or pressure matching constraint.
protocol.sector_quality_filter: 72 azimuth sectors, fitted amplitude/residual-rms proxy >=4, successful fit, centre and width away from bounds. Not a statistical confidence interval.
protocol.temperature_qualification: Room temperature assumed for three extra series. Their run-specific temperatures are not recovered; suffixes do not prove temperature. A source-law 293 K correction is approximately -0.039 GPa if these were room-temperature measurements.

calibration_screenshots.source: Visually transcribed from original embedded 1920x1080 PNG screenshots in the beamtime Word documents. Not OCR text.
calibration_screenshots.coordinate_conversion: pyFAI Fit2D geometry; evaluate FabIO MAR rows with row_fit2d=3071-row_fabio. Pixel-centre convention is handled by pyFAI.
calibration_screenshots.reference_standard: Installed pyFAI Si; original Fit2D calibrant d-spacing list is not saved in these screenshots.

conclusion.usable_result: Three additional series are near 46-47 GPa on the assumed room-temperature Fei Ne scale. Approximate independent estimates, not recovered original ruby observations.
conclusion.remaining_absolute_discrepancy: Seven accepted reference runs, using the preceding original calibration, lie about 0.9-1.3 GPa below their published ruby pressures. Geometry replay, peak clipping, cold-EOS branch and 293-versus-300 K correction do not close this discrepancy.
conclusion.uncertainty_limit: No justified experimental absolute pressure error bar or source confidence level recovered. Direction-dependent scattering and extra-run temperature remain limitations.
conclusion.existing_pressure_series: 19 final Table S1 P-V observations already available, separately from 22 digitized Figure 1 markers.
conclusion.graph_only_points: Nonambient graph-only points near 5.93 and 44.53 GPa remain unmapped. Indexed runs p20-p22 do not establish correspondence to these points.
conclusion.necessity_for_full_range_record: The current source full-range EOS and its conditional graph-based comparison do not depend on assigning pressures to these three extra runs.

initial_probe_correction: The earlier 12-frame-per-prefix glob included a final scout frame for some series. This follow-up separates exact prefix_NNN complete series and prefix_rot_NNN scout exposures; prior probe retained as history.
